scope: Independent visual review of actual GPU05 rendered stills and ordered 30 fps frames; no engine run or production-file modification. Contact sheets are resized inspection aids, not replacement render evidence.
observations_ko: 기존 비틀기/유지 구간에서 소매가 파지를 통째로 덮던 현상은 해소됨.
찌르기와 유지 중 소매가 화면 우측으로 이어지며 검 가드, 손가락, 진입 위치를 읽을 수 있음.
발검과 복귀 연속 프레임에서 큰 팔꿈치 반전, 손-검 분리, 경로 불연속을 발견하지 못함.
측면과 파지 확대에서 손목/검의 연결이 유지됨.
observations_en: Previous gross sleeve occlusion of the held grip is resolved.
The sleeve extends from the right while the guard, fingers and entry location remain readable during stab/hold.
No gross elbow flip, hand/sword separation or path discontinuity was found through ordered extraction/recovery frames.
Side and grip closeups retain the wrist/weapon relationship.
remaining_qualifications: The source sleeve is visually broad and still occupies the lower-right foreground; this is an aesthetic characteristic rather than the prior whole-grip occlusion.
Previously disclosed index-to-middle spacing remains; this review does not claim perfect anatomy.
Ordered still review is not real-time video playback or physical-input validation.
This review makes no new exact mesh-contact, penetration, or collision claim.
